name: Porto Half Marathon 2026
description: Thousands of runners will take to the streets for one of Europe's most beautiful half marathons. Find a spot along the Douro riverfront to cheer them on and soak up the electric atmosphere.
longDescription:
The Porto Half Marathon 2026 is an annual road running event attracting participants from around the world. Organized by Runporto, it offers a 21.1-kilometer course designed to showcase the city's riverside landscape. The event serves as a significant fixture in the European running calendar, drawing both competitive athletes and recreational runners.

Spectators can line the City Waterfront to observe the race unfold. The atmosphere along the Douro riverfront is typically energetic, with crowds gathering to support the runners. The event is held outdoors, utilizing the public spaces along the river, and is suitable for a general audience interested in sports and community events.

Access for spectators is free of charge. The City Waterfront is accessible via various public transport options, including tram lines and bus routes that run along the river. It is also within walking distance from central areas of Porto. The event is family-friendly, offering an open environment for all ages.
